home.heroTitle: Empowering Rural Jharkhand Through Higher Education Innovation
home.heroSubtitle: Connecting grassroots village challenges in water, electricity, and roads directly with university engineering research and hackathons.
home.welcomeGreeting: Johar! Welcome to JAGRIT — Jharkhand Academia Industry Gateway for Research, Innovation and Transformation of Society.
home.welcomeTagline: Transforming rural challenges into applied engineering hackathons across 42 Higher Education Institutions in Jharkhand.
home.actionCardReportDesc: Submit village issues using compressed site photos and clear audio voice recordings.
home.actionCardWhatsAppDesc: Chat directly on WhatsApp with our civic bot. Send voice notes, photos, or location without installing any application.
home.servicesSubtitle: Direct problem submission, automated WhatsApp intake, and lifecycle resolution tracking
home.domainsSubtitle: High priority rural challenges solved by university research labs
home.step1Desc: Speak or write your grievance in Santhali, Hindi, or English via Web or WhatsApp.

home.step3Desc: Engineering student teams build durable field prototypes with milestone escrow funding.
home.step4Desc: 45-day village field test and democratic citizen quorum approval before project closure.
